name: Even Breathing
description: Six slow, even breaths: four seconds in, four seconds out.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Six even breaths: four seconds in, four seconds out, on Breathing Space.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Follow the shape for as many rounds as you like.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready.
Breathe in while the shape grows and out while it shrinks.
Press Pause or Restart whenever you want.
tips: Breathe in a way that feels easy. If anything feels uncomfortable, stop and breathe normally.
